en.name: Eevee
en.description: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.effect: Put a random card that evolves from Eevee from your deck into your hand.

fr.name: Évoli
fr.description: Ses multiples évolutions lui permettent de s'adapter à tout type de milieu naturel.

attacks.name: Signes d'Évolution
attacks.effect: Ajoutez au hasard une carte Évolution d'Évoli de votre deck à votre main.

es.name: Eevee
es.description: Es capaz de evolucionar de muchas maneras para adaptarse sin problemas a cualquier medio.

attacks.name: Indicios de Evolución
attacks.effect: Pon 1 carta aleatoria que evolucione de Eevee de tu baraja en tu mano.

it.name: Eevee
it.description: La capacità di evolversi in diverse specie gli permette di adattarsi perfettamente a qualsiasi tipo di ambiente.

attacks.name: Evolisegni
attacks.effect: Prendi una carta a caso dal tuo mazzo che si evolve da Eevee e aggiungila alle carte che hai in mano.

de.name: Evoli
de.description: Um sich jeder Umgebung perfekt anpassen zu können, ist es in der Lage, sich zu verschiedenen Pokémon zu entwickeln.

attacks.name: Spuren der Evolution
attacks.effect: Nimm 1 zufällige Karte, die sich aus Evoli entwickelt, aus deinem Deck auf deine Hand.

pt-br.name: Eevee
pt-br.description: Sua capacidade de evoluir para muitas formas permite que se adapte fácil e perfeitamente a qualquer ambiente.

attacks.name: Sinais de Evolução
attacks.effect: Coloque 1 carta aleatória que evolua de Eevee do seu baralho na sua mão.

zh-tw.name: 伊布
zh-tw.description: 為了能順應周遭環境的變化，讓伊布可變身為許多種進化的可能性。

attacks.name: 進化預兆
attacks.effect: 從自己的牌庫隨機將1張從「伊布」進化而來的卡加入手牌。
